svg.text: T19 • MYTH VS. REALITY
BEST FOR: CONTRARIAN CLARITY
GOOGLE CLOUD + OPEN-SOURCE PARITY
DYNAMIC TEMPLATE • LIVE SIGNAL PACKETS
Five Agentic AI Myths That Quietly Break Production — and the Grounded Reality Behind Each
Every myth assumes the model will self-regulate; every reality adds a deterministic control outside the model — available as a Google Cloud service or an open-source project.
❌ COMMON MYTH (WHAT TEAMS ASSUME)
✅ GROUNDED REALITY (WHAT PRODUCTION PROVES)
MYTH 1
A bigger context window fixes forgetting — just paste
everything in.
Cost: 54% rule adherence by turn 15 and 35-second turns.
GROUNDED FIX
REALITY 1
Recall degrades as distractors accumulate, well below the token limit. Pin rules in
a prefix cache (Vertex KV / vLLM), isolate noisy reads in subagents, swap >2KB
outputs for pointers.
Chroma 'Context Rot' study • IDEA-02 (97% adherence at turn 30+)
MYTH 2
Better prompt wording can stop prompt injection.
Cost: one poisoned PDF exfiltrates data through your own tools.
GROUNDED FIX
REALITY 2
Instructions and data share one token stream; architect around it — scan ingress
(Model Armor or Llama Guard), taint the session, physically unmount write tools via
OPA / IAM.
POST-05 • Model Armor / Llama Guard / NeMo Guardrails • IDEA-08
MYTH 3
The agent knows when it is done.
Cost: 38% of 'completed' tasks fail on the first run.
GROUNDED FIX
REALITY 3
'Done' is exit_code == 0 from a sandboxed verification hook (OpenHands, E2B, Cloud
Run gVisor) — never an LLM sentence. Bounce the traceback back until it passes.
OpenHands (MIT) CodeActAgent • IDEA-03 (0% unverified escapes)
MYTH 4
More tools make the agent more capable.
Cost: 35,000 schema tokens per turn and 31% wrong tool calls.
GROUNDED FIX
REALITY 4
Attention dilutes across overlapping schemas. Index every MCP tool (AlloyDB pgvector
or Qdrant), mount only the Top-3 per step, unmount after the call.
IDEA-04 dynamic MCP router (96.4% accuracy, -93% tokens)
MYTH 5
Five specialist agents beat one well-harnessed agent.
Cost: 42% of requirements lost across three prose handoffs.
GROUNDED FIX
REALITY 5
Agents should mutate a shared, schema-validated blackboard (Firestore or PostgreSQL
JSONB + Pydantic) — not paraphrase each other in chat. Typed contracts keep 100% of
constraints.
A2A task contracts (Linux Foundation) • Pydantic • IDEA-05
THE PATTERN BEHIND ALL FIVE
Each myth asks the model to police itself; each reality moves the control into deterministic code (hashes, exit codes, schemas, taint flags) that the model cannot talk
its way around — on Google Cloud or self-hosted.
Curated by Nitin Aggarwal • Google Cloud ADK + OpenHands Factory • Proprietary + Confidential
Sources: Chroma context-rot study • POST-05 • IDEA-03 • IDEA-04 • IDEA-05 • Llama Guard • Pydantic
